articles.summary: SHENZHEN, China, June 26, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Xunlei Limited (“Xunlei” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: XNET), a leading technology company providing distributed cloud services in China, today announced that the board of directors of the Company (the “Board”) has approved a new share repurchase
articles.title: Xunlei Announces US$20 Million Share Repurchase Program
